notes: James A. Martin Color Slides of San Francisco (SFP 169) — an amateur's colour slides of the city in 1965-68, given to the library with the donor's own notes. Those notes end in a modern geocoded street address on 549 of the 918 records, and it names the viewpoint rather than the subject; the extractor reads only a number the donor states in the descriptive half of the note, keeps the geocode in extra.donor_geocode_as_recorded, and states the disagreement as a conflict. See the dossier.

coverage.remaining: None. The collection was read whole.
coverage.note: 918 records read; 70 give an exact street number, 48 of them from the donor's own note rather than the title; 775 give none and were skipped; 46 were skipped as photographs of people. 39 findings over 34 distinct addresses; 21 resolved, 18 unresolved — six of them buildings EAS no longer holds, six a landmark named for scale in a street photograph ("555 Market in background"), and the rest a viewpoint, a typo the donor made ("100 Larking Street"), a range now split across parcels and two places the register does not treat as streets.
